meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白糖基化位点，辅助抗体优化与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正从事糖蛋白工程或治疗性抗体优化
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to aid antibody optimization and vaccine design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on glycoprotein engineering or therapeutic antibody optimization

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude能分析蛋白质序列，找出N-糖基化位点（N-X-S/T模式）并预测O-糖基化热点，还能提供修改糖基化位点的代码片段，以及引导使用NetOGlyc、GlycoShield等外部工具。
howto.when: 当你需要分析或设计蛋白质的糖基化修饰时触发，例如优化抗体Fc区糖基化、设计疫苗抗原、研究蛋白稳定性等。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个蛋白序列的N-糖基化位点。
say.note: Claude会运行N-糖基化位点扫描函数并输出结果。

say.text: 预测这个抗体Fc区的O-糖基化热点。
say.note: Claude会调用O-糖基化预测函数给出候选位点。

say.text: 如何剔除某个糖基化位点？比如将Asn改为Gln。
say.note: Claude会展示剔除位点的代码示例。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can analyze protein sequences to identify N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, provide code to modify glycosylation sites, and guide users to external tools like NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, and GlycoWorkbench.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze or engineer protein glycosylation, e.g., optimizing antibody Fc glycans, designing vaccine antigens, or studying protein stability.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Claude runs the N-glycosylation sequon scanner and outputs results.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots on this antibody Fc region.
say_en.note: Claude uses the heuristic hotspot predictor to identify candidates.

say_en.text: How do I remove a glycosylation site? For example, mutate Asn to Gln.
